states.title: States (practice location)
states.description: Two-letter codes such as CA, TX, NY. Leave empty for all states and territories.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Broad groups (our own labels) based on the provider's self-selected primary taxonomy code: not a licence, board certification or verified specialty. Leave empty for all. For an exact specialty use taxonomy codes below.

taxonomyPrefixes.title: Taxonomy codes (or their start)
taxonomyPrefixes.description: Matches the primary taxonomy code, e.g. 207Q00000X (family medicine), 261QU0200X (urgent care), or a prefix such as 261Q (all clinics). Code list: nucc.org.

organizationNameContains.title: Organization name contains
organizationNameContains.description: Only organizations whose legal name, DBA or parent organization contains one of these words, e.g. DENTAL, URGENT, HOME HEALTH.

excludeSubparts.title: Exclude organization subparts
excludeSubparts.description: Subparts are new locations or units of an existing organization (e.g. a hospital system's new clinic). Turn on to get only standalone new organizations.

weeks.title: Weekly files to read
weeks.description: CMS publishes only the two latest weekly files. With "only new" on, 2 means a weekly or bi-weekly schedule misses nothing.

onlyNew.title: Only NPIs not output before (for schedules)
onlyNew.description: Remembered per filter set in a named key-value store. Turn off to get the whole window every time.

includeIndividualStreetAndPhone.title: Include street address and phone of individual providers
includeIndividualStreetAndPhone.description: Off by default: CMS notes that some individual providers (e.g. telehealth) list their home as practice location. When off, individuals get city, state and 5-digit ZIP only. Organizations always include practice address and phone.

includeAuthorizedOfficial.title: Include authorized official name and title (organizations)
includeAuthorizedOfficial.description: The person who registered the organization's NPI and their title. Their phone number is never output.

maxItems.title: Max providers per run
maxItems.description: You are charged per provider stored, so this caps the cost of a run. About 10,000 NPIs are created nationally each week. Providers cut by the limit stay new for the next run.

stateStoreName.title: State store name (advanced)
stateStoreName.description: Leave empty to use the default.
